verdict.rationale: Folk documents a REST API that can read deals through the custom object endpoints, and an official MCP server usable from Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini, with use cases such as finding relationships and logging meetings. So an agent could pull some account context. Gmail conversations sync into folk, but nothing shows those emails or the interaction history being readable through the API or MCP, and no pre-meeting brief workflow is documented. Missing for 10: API/MCP access to recent emails and interaction history, a documented account-brief or meeting-prep use case, hands-on corroboration.
